scope.description: Review-first refresh of ten published launch-era company profiles with generic capability records and insufficient decision context.

source.title: Adaptive Marine Solutions services
source.locator: Marine engineering, modelling, refit, survey and lifecycle services
source.summary: Adaptive Marine Solutions describes Canadian naval architecture, marine engineering, three-dimensional modelling, refit, survey, and lifecycle-support services.

leads.evidenceLocator: Marine engineering, modelling, refit, survey and lifecycle services
followUpQuestions: Confirm current vessel programs, contracted work packages, design and configuration authority, accepted milestones, qualified staffing, and near-term capacity before treating the portfolio as available defence delivery.
reviewWarnings: The public record does not establish design authority by vessel, final workshare, accepted deliverables, current staffing capacity, or whether every described service is available for defence programs.
